run_train_baseline: run the train_baseline function to train a BERT model using raw MS-AMP with opt_level O2
run_train_integration: run the train_integration function to train a BERT model using Accelerate with FP8 MS-AMP backend
run_non_distributed_benchmark: run the non_distributed benchmark script to compare Accelerate FP8 performance against raw MS-AMP on single GPU
review_train_baseline: review the train_baseline function that initializes MS-AMP and trains a model with gradient scaling
review_train_integration: review the train_integration function that uses Accelerator with FP8RecipeKwargs for mixed precision training
